description:
Growing Food on Mars 🌱🔴

Hi! I’m Đức Anh, a Software Engineering student at FPT University, Vietnam. I build iOS apps and automated irrigation for my own farm. Our goal: grow food on Mars despite toxic perchlorate soil, using greenhouses, sensors and AI. A real problem NASA is still working on! Looking for: hardware, agriculture, AI/ML, data analysis & visualization, design, and Mars science. Curious? Join us!
